test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 17 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Town B is to the east of Town A. Town C is to the north of Town B. Town D is to the east of Town C. Town E is to the south of Town D. What is the position of Town E with respect to Town A? (All positions are arranged in GRID pattern)
solution:
Given: 

Town B is to the east of Town A. 

Town C is to the north of Town B. 

Town D is to the east of Town C. 

Town E is to the south of Town D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/88065e25d2ae1fd608cb1149eb3225e00efb9d7a87273fa702e8f7a3e2ca3157.png] 

Here, we can clearly see that Town E is in East with respect to Town A.

Hence, the correct answer is **"East"**.
